@graph.name: Neuvision
@graph.description: Neuvision generates AI TVC, film, and UGC in variants, tests them against real audiences, and scales the one that wins.

@graph.name: AI TVC
@graph.description: Broadcast-polish commercials built to look professionally produced, with the brand front and centre. Suited to launches and categories where trust is the barrier to purchase.

@graph.name: AI Film
@graph.description: Brand film where the product sits inside a mood, a world, a feeling, rather than being announced. Asks a few extra seconds of patience from the viewer.

@graph.name: AI UGC
@graph.description: Briefed and graded to look unpolished and specific rather than generic. The format that tests fastest and cheapest, and the best first move in a batch.
